mission.display_title: Place GLM responses in the exponential family
mission.mission_purpose: Today's Mission exists to place binomial, Poisson, exponential, gamma and normal as exponential-family responses. So GLM starts from distributional honesty, without pretending mean/variance/scale (4.2.2) are finished.
mission.tutor_intent: Today I will force exponential-family placement for named responses and refuse 'GLM means linear regression in a package'.
mission.educational_intent: Produce family placement as the Continuity Front join hinge from Nu linear regression into Topic 4.2 structure.
mission.learning_objective: Recognise binomial, Poisson, exponential, gamma and normal distributions as members of an exponential family in the GLM setting.
mission.concept_focus: Named response distributions → exponential-family membership in the GLM setting → refuse package-name GLM.
mission.prior_bridge: Campaign Nu closed linear regression (4.1) with Revision. Today opens Continuity Front join at Topic 4.2 LO 4.2.1. The next official syllabus topic after 4.1. Trust Front CS1-003 already holds LIVE 4.2 inventory independently; Xi is the Continuity Front native Pilot Arc.

mission.expected_benefit: You will be able to recognise binomial, Poisson, exponential, gamma and Normal as exponential-family GLM responses.

knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 4.2.1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. (1) List five distributions named in 4.2.1 as exponential-family GLM responses. (2) Mark which is the Normal special case. (3) Name one reason mean/variance is not today's LO.
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Binomial, Poisson, exponential, gamma, normal. Normal is the special case inside the family list, not the definition of GLM. Mean/variance is tomorrow.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 4.2.1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. (1) Name three of binomial, Poisson, exponential, gamma, Normal and state in one line why each belongs in the exponential family for GLM. (2) Refuse: 'GLM is just ordinary linear regression with a different software package name.'
knowledge_checks.model_answer: (1) e.g. Poisson (counts with E[Y]=Var[Y]=μ); binomial (bounded proportion/count responses); Normal (continuous responses with constant variance). Each has an exponential-family density form usable as a GLM response. (2) Refuse: package name ≠ GLM; a GLM response sits in an exponential family (with later η and link). Normal+identity is a special case, not the definition.
